title: LBJ pushes Earl Warren into the commission; Dulles runs it

tellings.quote: And he they lie to to Chief Justice Warren to Chief Justice Warren to get to chair the waring commission. And they put Alan Dulles on who was the de facto run guy that ran the Warren Commission,

plain: After President Kennedy was killed in 1963, the people around President Lyndon Johnson lied to Earl Warren, the Chief Justice of the US Supreme Court, to get him to chair the Warren Commission, the panel that investigated the killing. The lawyer Dan Sheehan says this without naming a source, and adds that Allen Dulles, the former head of the CIA, was put on the panel and was the man who really ran it. If true, it would mean the official inquiry into Kennedy's death was steered from the start.
